## Problem or opportunity

Describe the specific project problem. Link the related phase, decision record, runbook, evidence item, or lesson.

## Proposed outcome

State the smallest useful result. Do not describe a large tool collection or a broad platform redesign.

## Scope

| Include | Exclude |
|---|---|
| List the files, behavior, or test this issue covers. | List nearby work that this issue must not start. |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The implementation or document has a clear owner and location.
- [ ] The stated behavior has a defined verification method.
- [ ] The result updates related documentation, decision records, or evidence where needed.
- [ ] The change passes the data-classification and secret-handling rules.
- [ ] The issue identifies any dependency or user decision that blocks work.

## Evidence to capture

Name the evidence ID, test result, pull request, dashboard, screenshot, runbook update, or recording that will prove completion.

## Risk and privacy review

Describe any new secret, identity, permission, network route, persistent data, external integration, public artifact, or irreversible operation. Use `None` only after checking each category.
